title: Silverheels #1 2 3 Complete Series Pacific Comics 1983 Scott Hampton Bruce Jones
conditionDescription: All three covers bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. #2 has light wear along the spine edge and a small rub on the silver logo. See photos.
descriptionText:
Silverheels #1, #2 and #3 - the complete series (Pacific Comics, Dec 1983 - May 1984). Written by Bruce Jones with painted art by Scott Hampton. Original $1.50 cover price each.

You get all 3 issues:
- #1 (Dec 1983) - back cover: Somerset Holmes #2 ad
- #2 (Mar 1984) - back cover: Alien Worlds #7 ad (Richard Corben)
- #3 (May 1984) - back cover: Groo Special #1 ad (Sergio Aragones)

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
